label: Preexistence at the universal source: impersonal-source controls, checked (inference)
rule: Explicit finite interpretation over Fin 3 and Bool, checked by decision
meaning: One finite interpretation of an impersonal universal source. On the inclusive reading of act, universal transfer, universal-source possession and preexistence, q.4 a.2 preexistence, unrestricted transfer and the inclusive PERFECT_2 of the source all hold, while the source lacks life formally. A structural surrogate: it shows these premises do not by themselves give formal or intrinsic possession at the source; the virtual relation is stipulated, not a modelled power or containment.
